text: The residents of the area have requested that an all-way stop sign control be installed at the intersection of Ancaster Road and Regent Road. Although the investigation carried out by Transportation Services did not meet the numerical warrants for the installation of an all-way stop control, the residents feel that it would create a safer situation for pedestrians and motorists, especially since there is a church located at this intersection.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Ancaster Road and Regent Road.
